subject.title: fix(commands): bound reset-hook transcript reads to prevent OOM

question: What should `before_reset` plugins receive when the previous transcript exceeds a safe in-memory payload limit?
rationale: The shipped plugin event exposes a `messages` array and both reset paths currently attempt to provide the full transcript; truncation, recent-tail selection, and paging have different compatibility and implementation consequences.

options.title: Bounded recent tail
options.body: Keep the existing array shape, return the most recent messages under explicit total byte and message caps, and apply the same rule to both reset paths.

options.title: Paged access
options.body: Add a plugin-facing paging or reader capability so plugins can retrieve additional history without one transcript-sized allocation.

options.title: Retain full payload
options.body: Preserve complete transcript delivery and accept transcript-proportional memory, which means this PR cannot promise OOM prevention.

recommendation.title: Bounded recent tail
recommendation.body: Keep the existing array shape, return the most recent messages under explicit total byte and message caps, and apply the same rule to both reset paths.

likelyOwner.reason: The transcript-reader seam and sibling Gateway reset integration originate from their merged work, making them the strongest available owner for aligning the shared contract.
